notes.title: [Update] v1.0.5 Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482948/fd03788f0ece16c766b5602c9e21a20e98dd93fa.png[/img]

Hiya, Captain! Dorimi here with some awesome news! 🎸
Phew... You saved my life with all that amazing feedback! I was seriously going crazy trying to figure out what to improve next, haha!

Now, let's move right on to the update details!!

[h3]🎵 New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Settings Renewal with Standby Feature (Live Settings)[/b] - Whoa! Now you can adjust settings on the fly! No more getting dizzy trying to remember what you wanted to change!
[*] [b]Sync Value Adjustment[/b] - You can now fine-tune sync values in the settings! Perfect timing, just like my guitar solos~!
[*] [b]Custom Key Binding for Keyboard[/b] - Set up your controls however you want! Way better than being stuck with defaults, right?
[*] [b]Settings Access in Mode Select[/b] - Open settings right from the mode select scene! So convenient~!
[/list]
[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Travel Mode Text Issue[/b] - Fixed that annoying problem where text would peek through behind the scene title during music selection scrolling. I totally rocked that fix!
[/list]

Honestly, I think this update turned out really well... I'm so happy about all these improvements~!

Thank you so much for playing and giving us feedback! 

Now go enjoy the updated features, Captain!! 🎶

notes.title: [Update] Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER v1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:

Hiya, Captain! It's me again! 🎸

Thank you so, so much for playing "Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER"!
Seeing people around the world enjoying our game... it's like a dream come true! Really!!

And thanks to that, we were able to catch some issues that require immediate attention!
You know how it is - the more people play, the more we discover what needs fixing. That's teamwork, right? Haha!

[h3]🔧Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where achievement "Encore" could not be unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue where there was no keyboard input guide in the tutorial
[*] Updated the store resources with fully localized ones
[/list]

Phew... You saved my life! Well, saved our game's life! I was seriously worried about these issues.

Whenever you find issues or have feedbacks, feel free to let us know!
We're always listening and working to make everything perfect for you, Captain!

Thanks for sticking with us! Now let's get back to rocking! 🎵

notes.title: [NEWS] Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482948/efc0cfa67ba2bb8368e2a83b31744d8760960c96.png[/img]

Whoa! Captain! Perfect timing, I was just looking for you!

[u][b]Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER is officially released![/b][/u]

Awesome~! I totally rocked that guitar solo~!! And now you can experience the full adventure with me!

Get 10% off for the next 2 weeks! What is there to be curious about? With this discount, you'd be crazy not to take it!

Also, we are releasing 2 DLCs together!
Your library will be full of beautiful music! Nothing special? These songs are definitely special!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3791510
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3791520

[h2]🎸 Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Full Voiceover[/b] - That's right! You'll hear my energetic voice throughout the entire journey! Hehe!
[*] [b]Full Controller Support[/b] - Dualsense, Dualshock, Xbox, Pro-Con... you name it! With Steam Input support, any controller works perfectly!
[*] [b]Key Binding for Keyboard Users[/b] - I heard you and we're working hard on it! You'll be able to customize keyboard binding soon!

[h2]🚀 Roadmap[/h2]

[/list][b]07/21 PDT[/b]
[list]
[*] Standby Mode (Live Settings Support)

[*] Episode 3 update
[/list][b]August[/b]
[list]
[*] Mode Selection Renewal
[/list][b]September[/b]
[list]
[*] New DLC Release
[*] Episode 4 update
[/list]

Phew... You saved my life! Now let's rock this galaxy together, Captain!

Alright, alright!! Thank you everyone!! Let's move right on to the next song!!

notes.title: Dorimi’s First Feedback Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482948/8a1d51a1ca0c26a6ce1abfddbdb5410c10a7f71e.png[/img]

Hiya, Captain! It’s Dorimi here! 🎸
Thank you so, so much for loving our demo!
We’ve been reading through all your wonderful reviews and feedback.

And now—[b]our first update based on your input[/b] is here!

[h3]📌 Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where music cover images were stretched in the background
[*] Borderless mode now displays pillarboxes on widescreens instead of stretching the image
[*] Fixed distortion in button key guide images
[*] Added a “Demo” tag below to the title logo
[*] Adjusted default sound volume
[*] Default language now follows your operating system’s language automatically
[/list]

Also—if your feedback wasn’t included in this update, don’t worry!
We’re fully aware of it, and doing our best to bring those improvements to you in the near future. 🎵

We’re always listening and working to make the experience even better.
Thank you again from the bottom of our hearts! 🎶
